4515.title: Continuous working-indicator mask activity
4515.rootCauseOneLine: Visible active cues use an indefinitely looping 30-frame-per-second APNG mask; its contribution to macOS WindowServer CPU remains unmeasured here.
4515.proposedFix: Measure real macOS window and compositor cost for the current mask and a lower cadence before selecting a change.
4515.caveats: Static animation behavior was verified in two clean checkouts; the reported macOS CPU difference and display presentation rate were not reproduced.
